name: Fear & Greed Index
rule: Long when the Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads Extreme Fear (25 or below); cash when it reads Extreme Greed (76 or above). The index is published once a day; the rule uses the value already published at each daily close.
credit: Crypto Fear & Greed Index by Alternative.me, used with attribution: https://alternative.me/crypto/fear-and-greed-index/ (not a TradingView script: this rule is not cross-checked against TradingView)
conditions: Long only, 100% of equity, 0.1% commission per side, no slippage, fills at next open, default settings, trading from 2020-08-11.

text.en: Since 2020 this rule closed 6 trades and won 3 (50%). A trade lasts about 8 months on average. Its best trade was +25% (July 2024 to October 2024) and its worst −49% (November 2021 to January 2024). Without its three best trades, the other 3 together lose 71%. In 2025 it returned −24%; buying and holding Solana returned −34%. In 2021 it returned −14%; buying and holding Solana returned +11,178%. It buys fear and sells euphoria, the opposite of a trend rule: in long rallies it sells early and waits months for a fear that does not come.
text.es: Desde 2020 esta regla cerró 6 operaciones y ganó en 3 (50 %). Una operación dura en promedio unos 8 meses. La mejor fue +25 % (julio de 2024 a octubre de 2024) y la peor −49 % (noviembre de 2021 a enero de 2024). Sin sus tres mejores operaciones, las otras 3 juntas pierden 71 %. En 2025 rindió −24 %; comprar y mantener Solana rindió −34 %. En 2021 rindió −14 %; comprar y mantener Solana rindió +11.178 %. Compra con miedo y vende con euforia, al revés que una regla de tendencia: en las subidas largas vende temprano y espera meses un miedo que no llega.

disclaimer: Simulated backtest, not real performance. Not investment advice.
